# UX round on live `c3d1112` (5 Nov 2026, 23:00–23:45)

Live build `c3d1112` (PR #103, T-061; `build-sha` read from the page). Testers: Claude with Test 3 (organisation admin of `Institutní chata (test)`, member of `Chata Alfa (test)`; built-in browser, 375 px phone and desktop, English and Czech) and Test 5 (family admin of `Chata Test 5 (test)`; Claude in Chrome, desktop). Every screen of the signed-in app was opened; each was checked for horizontal scroll, tap targets under 44 px, unlabeled controls, text under 15 px and Czech text running off screen, then read as a 45–68-year-old user would. Nothing was saved; no links of other cottages were opened.

## Checked first

| Check                                               | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| T-061: Settings → Public request form → Back        | Pass: the arrow returns to Settings; the same link loaded fresh shows no arrow                                                                                                                               |
| O-22: Settings → Guest booking link, twice (Test 5) | Pass: the same link both times                                                                                                                                                                               |
| O-24 today: New booking, arrival = departure        | The app already allowed it (Confirm on), while the error text said "Departure must be after arrival". The public calendar let a visitor pick the same day, then the server refused it with "Check the dates" |
| Every screen at 375 px, English and Czech           | No horizontal scroll, no crash, no unlabeled control, no tap target under 44 px outside the calendar grid (43 × 44, fine)                                                                                    |

Language switch keeps the page.

## Recheck after publish (T-062 with 0044 applied)

1. Calendar → tap 13 Nov twice → Continue: the line says "Chosen: 13.11.2026 – 13.11.2026…", under the dates "Day visit (no overnight)"; Confirm is on. Do not save.
2. While picking, your day is an outlined circle; confirmed stays stay solid.
3. Family test cottage with the public calendar off (Test 5: switch it off first): Settings → Public calendar link asks "Publish the cottage calendar?"; Cancel leaves it off; "Publish and share" publishes and shares. A second tap shares without asking.
4. Public calendar of the test cottage, signed in as a non-member: pick the same day twice → "Day visit (no overnight)"; sending is accepted (decline it afterwards as admin).
5. Home of an organisation: three different icons; the picture shows at once.
6. Maintenance in Czech at 375 px: all five filters visible. Document Vault of a cottage without documents: "Add the first document".
